messages:
katie: @sre_julie heads-up: Acme (cust-acme) opened a support ticket — p95 for POST /v1/generate jumped to ~820ms and p99 ~1.4s starting around 08:10 UTC. Some callers also seeing intermittent 401s. ticket #12345. Any ideas for quick mitigation?

sre_julie: can you paste a couple request IDs and any sample headers? i'll check egress paths and recent route churn.

katie: req ids: req_0ab12cd3, req_0ab12cd7. snippet from their logs: `2024-06-15T08:11:02Z req_0ab12cd3 TLS handshake 760ms -> 200` and `2024-06-15T08:12:01Z req_0ab12cd7 auth failed 401 after 1.2s`. No deploys on our side since 07:50.

ryan: looking at edge metrics, we had a brief anycast change where eu-west-1 egress pref shifted — some flows got hairpinned via us-east-2 for ~6m. BGP flaps correlated with resolver TTLs.

ryan: traceroute from one of their failing vantage points (they ran this):
```
traceroute to api.redwood.ai (35.214.10.5), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.4 ms
 2  ???  15 ms
 8  us-east-gw  210 ms  <-- hairpin hop
 9  eu-west-pop  12 ms
```

sre_julie: that hairpin explains handshake inflation. TLS session reuse is failing because connections tear down across the extra hop. quick mitigation: pin cust-acme to eu-west POP and flush DNS for their region so new connections prefer local egress. also push a short keepalive/session-ticket tweak server-side.

maria: i'll add a temporary route policy: route-cust-acme->eu-west-pop for 30m, TTL override to 60s. applying now.

ops-bot: (system) policy route-cust-acme->eu-west-pop applied by maria at 2024-06-15T08:20Z :white_check_mark:

support_alan: reached out to Acme with the mitigation. they ran a quick smoke and reported p95 dropped to ~180ms and p99 ~300ms for ~10 minutes. they still saw a couple of auth flakies.

sre_julie: looking at auth flow traces — a few failures line up with connection resets during handshake. enabling keepalive + TLS session tickets should reduce full-handshake count. i'll roll a small config change to session tickets on the auth tier (no deploy, config bump).

sre_julie: config change pushed to auth tier: `tls.session_tickets: enabled`, `conn.keepalive: 60s` — monitoring.

maria: metrics show handshake durations falling back to baseline within 2m of route fix + config change.

katie: customer confirmed improvement and appreciated the quick turnaround :thumbsup: I'll leave ticket open for follow-up on permanent routing affinity.

sre_julie: follow-ups: 1) investigate what caused the anycast preference shift (bgp/peering), 2) add automated egress-affinity policy for high-volume customers, 3) consider DNS TTL defaults for regions. assigning to networking team.

ryan: logging a networking postmortem and a runbook for pinning customers as emergency mitigation. dropping notes in #eng-infra.

katie: closing the loop here. thanks all.
